prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: square Android launcher icon concept for neuroTune, an app combining brain-signal experiments, personalized audio and meditation. Create one polished standalone icon, full bleed opaque square image, no presentation board or mockup, no rounded outer corners (OS will mask), no labels, lettering or watermark. Existing app brand palette teal #1F6F6A, deep green #183435 and mint/off-white #F0F5EF. Restrained premium contemporary design, bold simple symbol readable at 48 pixels, generous 22 percent safe margin. No tiny circuitry or decorative fine lines. Concept 1: Resonance. Deep dark teal background, centered mint symbol made of one fluid broad horizontal sine-wave flowing through an incomplete circular halo, suggesting sound, tuning and calm. Clean balanced geometry, flat graphic with very subtle light-to-mint tonal transition in the symbol, no 3D effects, no drop shadow.
